title: Geometry of Rényi Entropy on the Majorization Lattice
summary: Majorization is a stochastic ordering relation that compares the relative diversity of probability distributions with numerous applications in econometrics, spectral theory, and ecology. It is well-known that the majorization partial order forms a complete lattice on the set of ordered probability distributions. In this work, we study the properties of Rényi entropy on the majorization lattice.
